'''Rosen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who travelled with [[Carewa]], [[Benchar]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Cecil]]. They visited the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] where they engaged in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="FC" />
